audit.adaptation_reason: The source labels two angles vertical/supplementary to52 degrees as108 and118 degrees. Corrected both to128 degrees, preserving the52-degree and30-degree data that determine the requested arc.
audit.independent_solution: Angle BFE=30 intercepts arc BE=60. For intersecting chords,52=(arc BE+arc CF)/2, so arc CF=104−60=44 degrees.
